Dialogs.Dialog: Don't expect me to pose like a real model, okay？
I'm in your hands, Mr. Photographer. Hehe.
Hehe, I'm getting a little nervous.
Um, I'll do my best too, okay？
No taking weird photos, got it？
I wonder how they'll turn out. I'm looking forward to it!
We should probably wrap things up soon, don't you think？
Hey, haven't you taken enough already？
Oh, wow. Quite a bit of time slipped by, huh.
Let's call it for now. We can do more next time, okay？
Yeah, I got plenty of shots.
Hehe, you took quite a lot, didn't you？
Aww. Make sure you take more like this again, okay？
Yeah. I totally lost myself in shooting today.
Why don't we stop soon？ You must be getting tired, too.
...Maybe so. Let's wrap it up, then.
Time out! That's enough for now, right？
Ah... Sorry, I completely lost track of myself.
Hey, let's wrap it up already.
Oh, right. Maybe I took a few too many.
Yeah. Guess we'll leave it at that for today.
You were working hard! Did they turn out well？
Don't worry. I got plenty of good ones.
Um, haven't you taken enough already...？
Ah, sorry. I was snapping away nonstop, wasn't I.
Hey, did you notice I'm getting tired？
Sorry, I'm getting a little worn out.
I see... Let's stop here, then.
Phew. I guess I was a bit too tense. Sorry.
Let's take it easy next time.
Hehe, maybe I need a little more practice？
Yeah... Well, that's enough for today.
Looks like ●'s getting a bit tired, too...
Photos are nice, but I want to chat, too.
Yeah... Guess I should ease up a bit.
Camera this, camera that... I'm your girlfriend, not the camera, right？
If you only take photos, we can't talk. I'm a little lonely...
Sorry, but... could you please stop？
No more, okay？ You understand, right？
Ugh... Did I get too carried away？
You're taking way too many. Bad boy!
I'd love it if you took a pretty picture of me.
Fufu. Make me look pretty, Mr. Photographer.
As long as your heart's in focus, it'll turn out pretty, right？ Just kidding!
Try and capture some expressions you don't usually see on me, okay？
I hope it turns out to be a wonderful photo.
Sorting through photos is so much fun, isn't it？
Let's take lots of photos of the two of us, okay？
That's another memory made. I can't wait.
Just like that, our memories keep growing one by one.
The memories stay with us, right along with the photos.
I want to make so many more memories with you.
Don't forget this moment today, okay？
Are you trying to fluster me, maybe？
Stop while I'm still smiling, okay？
I'm still a little shy. I hope I look pretty.
Make me look as pretty as you can, okay？
Hmm... Which angle makes me look the cutest, I wonder？
I'm excited to see how it turns out.
It's so nice watching our photos pile up, isn't it？
Let's make tons of memories together, okay？
Let's make special memories, just the two of us.
I won't forget today. You won't either... right？
Watching our memories grow bit by bit is so lovely.
Let's make lots of fun memories from now on, okay？
One photo at a time, our memories stay with us.
I'm asking you nicely, please stop.
Now, now, don't get carried away.
This is actually pretty nerve-wracking, isn't it？
My face isn't looking stiff, is it？
Being watched through the viewfinder is kind of... embarrassing.
You don't need to focus in so sharply, you know...？
Getting my picture taken is more embarrassing than I thought.
My face is starting to feel so hot...
I really don't know what kind of face to make...
Ah, make sure to let me know before you take it, okay？
Keeping my eyes open the whole time is surprisingly tiring.
Ah! I think I might've blinked just then.
Geez, why'd you take it out of nowhere？
Eek!? Geez, give me a warning first!
I'm getting pretty used to taking pictures now.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s really getting into the groove now.
Ooh, this might be a good one.
A good photographer never misses a photo op, right.
I'm gonna take some great photos today!
She seems in good form today.
Hope I can get some good shots.
Gotta do my best for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
Maybe I'll try something a little adventurous today.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s getting pretty used to this too.
All right, let's keep the energy up!
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks pretty great from this angle too.
Huh？ The focus won't lock on properly...
If ● doesn't keep it together, it'll just make ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ nervous.
How can I make sure this turns out pretty？
Please let this turn out nicely...
It's a special keepsake, so I've gotta do my best.
If I just stay calm, it'll be fine... probably.
Didn't think taking photos would make me this nervous...
Phew. Can I take a quick breather？
Just gonna relax for a sec♪
Wait, am I the only one having fun here？
I'm feeling really good right now.▼
Let's make some lovely memories today.
I might be... a little nervous.
If I look weird, tell me right away, okay？
I wonder why... I'm just not feeling it.
Do you really have to take it now？
Eek! Geez... What a naughty breeze.
Oh no... Did you see？ You didn't, right？
That's... kind of a problem, you know.
Um... I'm starting to feel embarrassed.
Staring like that... is kind of embarrassing.
You shouldn't be staring at weird spots, you know？
Are those the only parts you're interested in？
Hey... I feel a rather naughty gaze on me？
Hey! Keep that up and no more photos for you.
Geez... Now I don't know what to do with myself.
...Well, you're a guy after all, aren't you.
Hey... Are you just staring at my back？
Hey, um... You're making me super self-conscious.
You're not trying to take weird photos, are you？
Aw, look at you, such a spoiled boy▼
Eek... Don't startle me like that.
Huh!? Geez... You're such a prankster.
Hey! Geez, why are you like this...
...You've got that smirk. Don't tell me you took a picture just now？
Maybe we should stop taking photos now？
There are some pictures I don't want you taking, you know.
You just took a weird picture, didn't you？ That's not allowed.
Hey now. Do I need to punish you？
Hmm？ What are you taking pictures of？
There aren't many people around, huh.
It's not that I don't like it, but...
